title: Binary Search
description:
Write a function that performs binary search on a sorted array. Return the index of the target value, or -1 if not found.

Example:
- Input: [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11], 7 → Output: 3
- Input: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 6 → Output: -1
hints: Maintain left and right pointers. Check the middle element.
If target is larger, search the right half. If smaller, search the left half.
